latestVersion.changelog:
AI Video Editor APK Mod — Initial Release

- Edit and export videos online with AI-powered cloud processing—no modded APK required.
- Supports uploading MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM files up to 500MB; ideal for Android users and mobile creators.
- Automatic handling of token setup, session creation, and cloud backend connection.
- Offers guided editing workflows: trimming, transitions, color correction, adding text, audio tracks, and more via prompt.
- Free export of edited videos to MP4 or other popular formats.
- Provides real-time feedback, status checks, credits summary, and error handling for a smooth editing experience.
